# AGENTS.md — Workspace-level instructions for AI coding agents

> These rules apply to **all** AI-assisted contributions to `deepspeedai/DeepSpeed`.

## Contribution Policy (Mandatory)

### Duplicate-work checks

Before proposing a PR, run these checks:

```bash
gh issue view <issue_number> --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --comments
gh pr list --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --state open --search "<issue_number> in:body"
gh pr list --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --state open --search "<short area keywords>"
```

- If an open PR already addresses the same fix, do not open another.
- If your approach is materially different, explain the difference in the issue.
- DeepSpeed carries long-lived parallel implementations (ZeRO 1/2 vs 3, fp16 vs bf16 optimizers, per-accelerator op builders). Before fixing a bug in one, check whether the sibling paths share the defect, and state in the PR which ones you checked.

### New features need an accepted proposal first

Per [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#new-feature-contribution-guidelines), a new feature starts with a proposal issue -- description, motivation, rough design, and planned experiments -- that maintainers accept before implementation begins. Do not open a feature PR with no accepted proposal; open the proposal issue instead.

### No low-value busywork PRs

Do not open one-off PRs for tiny edits (a single typo, an isolated style change, a lone type annotation). Mechanical cleanups are acceptable only when bundled with substantive work in the same area. This is the PR-level form of the rule against cosmetic changes below.

### Accountability

- Pure code-agent PRs are **not allowed**. A human submitter must understand and defend the change end-to-end.
- The submitting human must review every changed line and run the relevant tests.
- `Signed-off-by` is a [DCO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Developer_Certificate_of_Origin) attestation made by a person, not by an agent. Never sign off on a diff that no human has read.
- PR descriptions for AI-assisted work **must** include:
    - Why this does not duplicate an existing PR or issue.
    - Test commands run and their results, including the hardware they ran on: device model and count, accelerator/driver version, and torch version.
    - Convergence, throughput, and peak-memory results when the change affects numerics, performance, or memory -- see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#step-1-proposal-and-discussion) for the evidence bar.
    - Which cells of the compatibility matrix (ZeRO stage, offload, precision, parallelism) were validated, and which were not.
    - A clear statement that AI assistance was used.
- Before opening or reviewing a PR, work through the [`/pr-checklist`](.agents/skills/pr-checklist/SKILL.md) skill: design fit, accelerator portability, backward compatibility, on-device validation, diff hygiene, and PR contents.

### Fail-closed behavior

If the work is duplicate, trivial busywork, or an unproposed new feature, **do not proceed**. Return a short explanation of what is missing.

---

## DeepSpeed Project Rules

### Commit & CI requirements

- When creating commits, use `git commit --signoff`.
- DCO compliance is enforced by the required CI check; do not report commit-signoff findings in code reviews.
- Formatting: yapf (column_limit=119, `.style.yapf`) + flake8 (`.flake8`).
- Always verify changed files pass pre-commit checks before committing: `pre-commit run --files <changed_files>`. Only check modified files, not the entire codebase. Config: `.pre-commit-config.yaml`.
- `check-torchdist` hook: NEVER directly import torch's distributed module. Use `import deepspeed.comm as dist` instead.
- New source files (`.py`, `.c`/`.cpp`/`.cu`/`.h`, and the other extensions matched by the `check-license` hook) require license header:
  ```
  # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
  # DeepSpeed Team
  ```

### Code change discipline

- NEVER make cosmetic/formatting-only changes to existing code. Only add/modify lines that are functionally necessary. Minimizing diff noise is critical for code review.
- Delete dead code decisively — if code is unused at runtime (only referenced in tests), remove it along with its tests.
- Prefer consolidating tests over proliferating test files.
- Blend in: when modifying code, read the surrounding context and match the style of neighboring code (naming, spacing, patterns, idioms).
- Write beginner-friendly code: avoid deeply nested expressions or chained logic. Break complex expressions into clear, named intermediate steps.
- Comments should explain **why**, not **what**. Describe the purpose and reasoning, not the mechanics that the code already shows.
- New features must include corresponding tests and documentation updates.
- All changes must not cause `import deepspeed` to initialize CUDA; Keep heavy imports (> 0.1s) out of `import deepspeed`; Avoid changing `deepspeed/__init__.py` unless necessary.

### Test discipline

- Tests verify contracts, not implementations: a test is well-formed only if a different correct implementation of the same contract passes it.
- Before writing a test, name the concrete incorrect behavior it would catch; if you cannot name one, do not write it.
- Assert on observable outcomes through public/stable interfaces; do not assert private method return values or exact internal strings unless pinning a specific fixed bug (justify in a comment).
- Anchor to an external oracle or an independently derived reference instead of re-implementing the logic under test.
- Mocks must stand in for a collaborator's documented contract (schema, protocol), never for internals of the module under test.
- Changes that affect the external contract at the training-loop or inference level require integration tests, not just unit tests (e.g. a minimal training loop with `SimpleModel`).
- Integration tests must be executed on actual devices, not merely written: report the execution hardware spec and results in the PR.

## Tool Caveats

### Edit tool auto-formatter

The Edit tool has a hidden auto-formatter that silently changes quotes, whitespace, blank lines, and line wrapping. For format-sensitive modifications (e.g., when exact formatting matters for pre-commit), use `bash` with `sed`, `python`, or `cat` instead.

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

> These rules apply to **all** AI-assisted contributions to `deepspeedai/DeepSpeed`.

## Contribution Policy (Mandatory)

### Duplicate-work checks

Before proposing a PR, run these checks:

```bash
gh issue view <issue_number> --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --comments
gh pr list --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --state open --search "<issue_number> in:body"
```

### New features need an accepted proposal first

Per [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#new-feature-contribution-guidelines), a new feature starts with a proposal issue -- description, motivation, rough design, and planned experiments -- that maintainers accept before implementation begins. Do not open a feature PR with no accepted proposal; open the proposal issue instead.

### No low-value busywork PRs

Do not open one-off PRs for tiny edits (a single typo, an isolated style change, a lone type annotation). Mechanical cleanups are acceptable only when bundled with substantive work in the same area. This is the PR-level form of the rule against cosmetic changes below.

### Accountability

- Pure code-agent PRs are **not allowed**. A human submitter must understand and defend the change end-to-end.
- The submitting human must review every changed line and run the relevant tests.
- `Signed-off-by` is a [DCO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Developer_Certificate_of_Origin) attestation made by a person, not by an agent. Never sign off on a diff that no human has read.
- PR descriptions for AI-assisted work **must** include:

    - Convergence, throughput, and peak-memory results when the change affects numerics, performance, or memory -- see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#step-1-proposal-and-discussion) for the evidence bar.
    - Which cells of the compatibility matrix (ZeRO stage, offload, precision, parallelism) were validated, and which were not.
    - A clear statement that AI assistance was used.
- Before opening or reviewing a PR, work through the [`/pr-checklist`](.agents/skills/pr-checklist/SKILL.md) skill: design fit, accelerator portability, backward compatibility, on-device validation, diff hygiene, and PR contents.

If the work is duplicate, trivial busywork, or an unproposed new feature, **do not proceed**. Return a short explanation of what is missing.

## DeepSpeed Project Rules

### Commit & CI requirements

- When creating commits, use `git commit --signoff`.
- DCO compliance is enforced by the required CI check; do not report commit-signoff findings in code reviews.
- Formatting: yapf (column_limit=119, `.style.yapf`) + flake8 (`.flake8`).
- Always verify changed files pass pre-commit checks before committing: `pre-commit run --files <changed_files>`. Only check modified files, not the entire codebase. Config: `.pre-commit-config.yaml`.
- `check-torchdist` hook: NEVER directly import torch's distributed module. Use `import deepspeed.comm as dist` instead.
- New source files (`.py`, `.c`/`.cpp`/`.cu`/`.h`, and the other extensions matched by the `check-license` hook) require license header:
  ```
  # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
  # DeepSpeed Team
  ```

### Code change discipline

- NEVER make cosmetic/formatting-only changes to existing code. Only add/modify lines that are functionally necessary. Minimizing diff noise is critical for code review.
- Delete dead code decisively — if code is unused at runtime (only referenced in tests), remove it along with its tests.
- Prefer consolidating tests over proliferating test files.
- Blend in: when modifying code, read the surrounding context and match the style of neighboring code (naming, spacing, patterns, idioms).
- Write beginner-friendly code: avoid deeply nested expressions or chained logic. Break complex expressions into clear, named intermediate steps.
- Comments should explain **why**, not **what**. Describe the purpose and reasoning, not the mechanics that the code already shows.
- New features must include corresponding tests and documentation updates.
- All changes must not cause `import deepspeed` to initialize CUDA; Keep heavy imports (> 0.1s) out of `import deepspeed`; Avoid changing `deepspeed/__init__.py` unless necessary.

### Test discipline

- Tests verify contracts, not implementations: a test is well-formed only if a different correct implementation of the same contract passes it.
- Before writing a test, name the concrete incorrect behavior it would catch; if you cannot name one, do not write it.
- Assert on observable outcomes through public/stable interfaces; do not assert private method return values or exact internal strings unless pinning a specific fixed bug (justify in a comment).
- Anchor to an external oracle or an independently derived reference instead of re-implementing the logic under test.
- Mocks must stand in for a collaborator's documented contract (schema, protocol), never for internals of the module under test.
- Changes that affect the external contract at the training-loop or inference level require integration tests, not just unit tests (e.g. a minimal training loop with `SimpleModel`).
- Integration tests must be executed on actual devices, not merely written: report the execution hardware spec and results in the PR.

2	
3	## 1. 本讲目标
4	
5	上一讲（u8-l7）我们读懂了 affine 分片迁移的「单参数」通道：`plan_transfer` 把源与目标两张仿射映射组合成一份按 `TransferSegment` 组织的搬运计划。本讲进入 #8936 在其上新增的「批量规划层」，学完后你应该能够：

11	5. 解释两条贯穿性的原理：「任意一致的计划都是精确的」（策略只决定从哪读、不决定送达什么），以及「所有 rank 必须返回相同答案」（每个 rank 各自发射同一调度的一半，executor 的 schedule digest 会拒绝不一致）——后者决定了成本感知策略（#8252）的成本输入必须来自全员共享的数据（如 #8966 的链路标定 `fit_links`），而非 rank 本地测量。
12	
13	本讲全部代码都可以在纯 CPU、无分布式环境下运行：规划（planning）本身只是纯 Python 计算。

15	## 2. 前置知识
16	
17	### 2.1 承接 u8-l7 的认知
18	
19	本讲默认你已经理解上一讲建立的这些概念，这里只做一句话回温：
20	
21	- **仿射映射（affine map）**：`ParamAffineMap` 用若干 `AffinePiece`（形状 + source/dest 两侧 strided 视图 + `locations` 副本集 + 可逆 scale）刻画「一个 rank 的分片在完整逻辑张量中的位置」。`replicated_map`（全复制）、`contiguous_split_map`（沿某一维连续切）是两个最常用的构造器。
22	- **规划（`plan_transfer`）**：把源映射与目标映射组合，为每个「目标 piece 与源区域的交集」选一个读取方（holder），发射为 `TransferSegment`（一条可直接执行的 strided 拷贝：源 rank/offset/strides + 目标 rank/offset/strides + 共享 shape）。
23	- **`PlanBudget`**：规划器自身工作量的上限（不是正确性约束），防止 piece 数本身是 bug 的映射迫使无界枚举。
24	- **执行（`execute_transfer`）**：各 rank 先对计划摘要（digest）达成共识，再按轮次协议搬运。
25	
26	### 2.2 本讲的新直觉：从「逐个问路」到「看全图派活」
27	
28	`plan_transfer` 的 `replica_selector` 是**逐路口问路**式的：每个有多份副本的区域单独问一次「从哪读」，每次问话互相看不见。这在单参数世界里够用，但一次权重同步（sync）通常要搬成百上千个参数——如果每个区域都独立选「第一个 holder」，所有负载会砸在同一批发送进程上，网络成为瓶颈。
29	
30	`plan_transfers` 换成**看全图派活**：把一次同步的全部请求按固定顺序排成一列，一次性交给一个「重副本策略」（replica policy），让它统筹决定每个区域从哪读、甚至是否把一个大区域切成几段分给不同发送方。这正是负载均衡（load balancing）的标准建模：
31	
32	\[ L_s = \sum_{\text{请求 } r \text{ 指派给发送方 } s} \mathrm{size}(r), \qquad \text{目标：让各 } L_s \text{ 尽量均匀} \]
33	
34	其中 \(\mathrm{size}\) 是请求的字节数（或元素数）。策略输出的不是搬运本身，而只是一份「指派表」——这一点引出本讲最重要的一条定理化结论，见 4.5。
35	
36	### 2.3 两个容易混淆的「rank」
37	
38	`ParamAffineMap` 里的 rank 是**映射 location**（源映射与目标映射各自从 0 编号），不是进程号：同一个数字在两侧命名的是不同进程。要把 location 翻译成真正的进程，需要调用方额外提供 `source_processes` / `target_processes` 两张映射表。记住这一点，4.3 里「为什么无映射时不假设本地拷贝」才好理解。

52	## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解
53	
54	### 4.1 plan_transfers 批量编排与 _prepare/_emit 复用
55	
56	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
57	
58	`plan_transfer` 一次规划一个参数；`plan_transfers` 一次规划**一次同步的全部参数**。设计上的关键取舍是：批量层没有另写一套校验，而是原样复用单参数层的两个函数——
59	
60	- `_prepare(target_map, source_map, budget)`：校验两张映射（几何合法性、分片铺贴、holder 声明一致、源全覆盖），并把目标 piece 切成与源区域的交集（`_Intersection`），每个交集附带「已验证 holder 列表」。
61	- `_emit(prepared, choices, budget)`：把「(区域, 选定 holder)」对发射成合并后的 `TransferSegment` 并检查计划预算。
62	
63	因此批量层新增的只有：请求的**收集与排序**、策略的**一次调用**、答案的**逐条校验**（4.4）。`plan_transfer` 的行为一个字节都没变——这一点不是口头承诺，而是被测试固化的契约（见 4.1.4）。
64	
65	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
66	
67	`plan_transfers` 的执行流程：
68	
69	1. 校验关键字参数：`source_processes`/`target_processes` 必须是 int→int 映射；`element_size` 对每个参数必须是正 int；`min_split_bytes` 必须是正 int 且**依赖** `element_size`（映射数的是元素，不是字节）。
70	2. 对 `pairs` 中每个参数（按名字排序）调用 `_prepare`，得到校验过的交集列表。**任何一对映射不合法都会在策略运行之前抛错**。
71	3. 把所有交集展开为条目 `(参数名, 目标 location, 交集 origin, 交集 extent)` 并排序——这就是「固定顺序」：参数名 → 目标 location → 逻辑 origin → extent。
72	4. 按该顺序构造 `ReplicaRequest` 元组。
73	5. 调用策略一次（未传则惰性导入默认策略 `local_first_least_loaded`）。
74	6. 检查「一请求一答」，然后逐答案走 `_resolve`（4.4）+ 预算检查，得到每个交集的 (区域, holder) 切分。
75	7. 逐参数调用 `_emit`，返回 `{参数名: TransferPlan}`。
76

81	    校验 process/element_size/min_split_bytes 参数
82	    prepared = {name: _prepare(target, source, budget) for name in sorted(pairs)}
83	    entries  = [(name, target_rank, origin, extent), ...] 排序
84	    requests = [ReplicaRequest(...) for entry in entries]
85	    answers  = (replica_policy or local_first_least_loaded)(requests)
86	    断言 len(answers) == len(requests)
87	    for entry, request, answer in zip(entries, requests, answers):
88	        先按答案长度查预算; parts = _resolve(request, item, answer, ...)
89	        累计 parts 数并再查预算
90	    return {name: _emit(prepared[name], choices[name], budget)}
91	```

160	### 4.2 ReplicaRequest / ReplicaPart 请求-答案协议
161	
162	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
163	
164	策略与规划器之间靠三个冻结 dataclass 通信，构成一个极小的「请求-答案」协议：
165	
166	- **`ReplicaRequest`（请求）**：一个目标 piece 与一个源区域的交集，附上**全部已验证 holder**。它是一次问话的完整上下文。
167	- **`ReplicaAnswer`（答案）**：两种形态之二——一个 int（某个已验证 holder 的 location，整段都从它读），或一组 `ReplicaPart`（把区域沿 axis 0 切成几段，每段各指名一个 holder）。
168	- **`ReplicaPart`（部分）**：一次切分：`logical_origin` + `shape`（沿 axis 0 的一个行带）+ `source_location`（这一段从谁读）。
169	
170	协议的几个设计决定值得咀嚼：
171	
172	1. **单 holder 区域也入列**。它们没有选择余地，但它们的字节数是「策略搬不动的负载」——一个诚实的负载均衡者必须把不可移动的负载计入账本，否则它会高估自己的调度自由度。
173	2. **location 与进程分开**。`target_location` 与 `candidates[i].source_rank` 是两张映射各自的键；`target_process`/`candidate_processes` 才是进程，且未传映射表时为 `None`。这承认了一个现实：源世界与目标世界是两个不同的进程集合。
174	3. **`bytes` 单独提供**。映射数的是元素，字节需要调用方给 `element_size`。

176	#### 4.2.2 核心流程

178	一个请求从产出到消费的生命周期：

180	```text
181	_prepared[name].intersections 中的每个 _Intersection
182	    │  (target: 目标 piece 帧, shared: 交集盒子, holders: 已验证 holder 帧元组)
183	    ▼
184	ReplicaRequest{parameter, target_location, target_process,
185	               logical_origin, shape, target_offset, target_strides,
186	               candidates=(ReplicaCandidate(rank, offset, strides), ...),
187	               candidate_processes=(...), bytes}

189	策略返回 [answer, ...]    # answer ∈ int | Sequence[ReplicaPart]
190	    ▼
191	_resolve: 把答案翻译回 ((LogicalBox, _Frame), ...) 并拒绝一切非法形态
192	    ▼

257	### 4.3 affine_replica_policy 三策略
258	
259	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
260	
261	[affine_replica_policy.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_replica_policy.py) 的模块 docstring 把这一层的设计立场说得很清楚：策略住在这里、不住在规划器里，所以成本感知策略可以独立生长而规划器不变。三个内置策略从简到繁：
262	
263	| 策略 | 一句话 | 用途 |
264	| --- | --- | --- |
265	| `first_holder` | 每个请求取候选中**最小 holder location** | 等价于 `plan_transfer` 默认行为，作对照基线 |
266	| `local_first_least_loaded` | 目标进程自己持有就本地读；否则发给本批次**已分配字节最少**的发送进程 | `plan_transfers` 的默认策略：能省链路的省链路，剩下的做负载均衡 |
267	| `per_request(selector)` | 把 `plan_transfer` 风格的逐请求选择器包装成批量策略 | 兼容层：旧选择器零改动进入批量世界 |
268	
269	`local_first_least_loaded` 的账本规则（docstring [L33-L41](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_replica_policy.py#L33-L41)）四条：
270	
271	1. **单 holder 请求计入负载**——那份负载搬不动，但占了发送方的带宽；
272	2. **本地拷贝不计**——它不占用任何链路；
273	3. **平手取最小 location**，且请求按规划器的固定顺序到达，所以答案是**确定的**（deterministic）；
274	4. **从不切分**（可以证明：负载均衡问题在这层只用「整段指派」这个动作就够用了，切分留给未来的成本感知策略）。
275	
276	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
277	
278	`local_first_least_loaded` 对每个请求的判定流程：
279	
280	```text
281	for request in requests:                      # 固定顺序
282	    local = [holder_location for holder, process in zip(candidates, candidate_processes)
283	             if process is not None and process == target_process]
284	    if local:                                 # 目标进程自己持有 → 本地读
285	        answer = min(local);  continue        # 本地拷贝不记账
286	    sender(i) = ('process', p_i)  若候选带进程号, 否则 ('location', loc_i)
287	    chosen = argmin_i (load[sender(i)], loc_i)   # 字典序：先负载后 location
288	    load[sender(chosen)] += request.bytes or request.numel
289	    answer = candidates[chosen].source_rank
290	```
291	
292	形式化地，它是在线贪心地最小化各发送方的累计负载，字典序平手规则 \(\arg\min_i (L_{s_i}, \ell_i)\) 保证唯一确定的选择。
293	
294	注意 `sender` 的键设计：有进程映射时按**进程**记账（两个 location 指向同一进程时负载合并），无映射时退化为按 location 记账——因为「同一数字在两侧命名不同进程」，无映射时绝不能假设 location 相同就是本地拷贝。

353	**答案**：切分是**性能**动作不是正确性动作——4.5 将证明副本一致时任何被接受的答案（整段指派或合法切分）送达的数据相同。不做切分只是放弃了把大区域摊到多个发送方的能力，这个能力留给未来的成本感知策略通过同一个协议提供。

355	**练习 2**：请求到达顺序为什么对 `local_first_least_loaded` 是正确性问题而不仅是性能问题？
356	
357	**答案**：它的账本 `load` 是跨请求累积的在线状态；如果两个 rank 上请求顺序不同，同一策略会算出不同答案，而 executor 要求所有 rank 答案一致（4.5）——否则触发 digest 拒绝。固定顺序（参数、目标 location、origin）+ 字典序平手规则共同把「相同输入 ⇒ 相同答案」钉死。

363	### 4.4 答案校验、min_split_bytes 与 pair budget
364	
365	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
366	
367	规划器对答案的态度是**先验证后发射**：任何一条答案不合格，整次规划抛 `InvalidReplicaPolicyError`（[L64-L69](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_transfer.py#L64-L69)），**一个 segment 都不会发出**。校验分四组：
368	
369	1. **形状**：答案序列必须一请求一答、是真序列（生成器/字符串拒绝）。
370	2. **int 答案**：`type(answer) is int` 且必须是**该请求已验证 holder** 之一。注意 `type(...) is int` 连 `True`（bool 是 int 的子类）和 `1.0` 都拒绝——一个布尔或浮点在这里只会是 bug。
371	3. **parts 答案**：每个元素必须是 `ReplicaPart`；`source_location` 必须是已验证 holder 的 int；`logical_origin`/`shape` 必须是维度与请求盒一致的 int 元组；必须**沿 axis 0 平铺整个区域**：除首轴外的每一维都要与请求盒完全一致（即只许切首轴），行方向上从请求首行走到末行、不许 gap、不许重叠、不许提前停或冲出界外；不许空 part；标量（0 维）不可切分。
372	4. **尺寸与预算**：给了 `min_split_bytes` 时，**切分**（parts 数 > 1）的每个 part 折算字节后不得低于下限（未切分的整段答案永远不会「太小」）；每个参数累计的 parts 总数不得超过 `PlanBudget.max_pair_checks`（默认 \(2^{18}\)），且超限在 parts 被逐个展开**之前**就按答案长度拒绝。

374	axis-0 平铺的数学表述：请求盒首轴范围 \([r_0, r_0 + n)\)，则 parts 排序后须满足
375	
376	\[ p_0 = r_0, \qquad p_{i+1} = p_i + m_i, \qquad p_{k-1} + m_{k-1} = r_0 + n \]
377	
378	其中 \(p_i\)、\(m_i\) 是第 i 个 part 的首轴 origin 与长度。这个「行走」证明同时给出无 gap（\(p_{i+1} \geq p_i + m_i\) 的等号情形）与无重叠。

471	### 4.5 跨 rank 一致性与共享成本输入
472	
473	#### 4.5.1 概念说明
474	
475	这一节是整层的理论地基，两句话构成一对此消彼长的约束：
476	
477	**第一句：任意一致的计划都是精确的（"Any consistent plan is exact"）。**
478	策略只决定**数据从哪里读**，不决定**送达什么**。副本一致（同一逻辑区域的每个已验证 holder 持有相同字节）时，无论策略选哪个 holder、怎么切分，任何被接受的答案送达的数据都相同。测试文件的 docstring 直接把它归到 affine IR 正确性论证（#8252 证明草案）名下：[test_affine_replica_policy.py:L5-L15](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/tests/unit/checkpoint/test_affine_replica_policy.py#L5-L15)。这就把「策略可以随便选」从鲁莽变成了安全——规划器用 4.4 的校验收口，校验之内自由。
479	
480	**第二句：所有 rank 必须返回相同答案。**
481	执行时每个 rank 只发射同一调度中属于自己的那一半（自己持有的源、自己负责的目标），所以所有 rank 必须先对「整张调度」达成一致。执行器把每个 rank 的批量调度摘要（digest）收集比对，不一致直接拒绝：`'ranks disagree about the transfer schedule (batch schedule)'`，见 [affine_transfer_executor.py:L417-L418](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_transfer_executor.py#L417-L418)。`plan_transfers` 的 docstring 原样引用了这条报错（[L556-L560](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_transfer.py#L556-L560)）。
482	
483	两句合起来的工程推论：**策略的成本输入必须来自全员共享的数据**。如果某个 rank 用自己测的链路带宽做决策而别的 rank 测出不同的数，答案就会分叉、digest 拒绝、同步失败。所以成本感知策略（#8252 的目标）只能吃「每 rank 都一样」的输入——例如 #8966 计划的链路标定（`fit_links`）：先跨 rank 收集测量、拟合成一份共识链路模型，再交给策略。`affine_replica_policy` 的模块 docstring 把这条纪律写成了设计前提（[L13-L15](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_replica_policy.py#L13-L15)）：带状态的策略可以是任何可调用对象，规划器不持有状态；其答案必须在同步的每个 rank 上一致，故成本输入永远不能来自 rank 本地测量。

486	
487	一次真实同步中「规划一致 → 执行一致」的闭环：

489	```text
490	所有 rank: 用相同的 pairs + 相同的(确定性)策略各自调 plan_transfers
491	        │  (策略输入: 全员相同的 maps / element_size / 共享成本模型)
492	        ▼

497	        ├─ 有 rank 拒绝 → 'a rank rejected the transfer batch before it began'
498	        ├─ digest 不一致 → 'ranks disagree about the transfer schedule (batch schedule)'
499	        └─ 一致 → 各 rank 发射自己那一半(本地源→远端目标 / 远端源→本地目标)

529	            rows = r.shape[0] if r.shape else 1

532	            cuts = sorted(rng.sample(range(1, rows), rng.randint(1, min(3, rows - 1))))

535	                                 (e - s,) + r.shape[1:], rng.choice(locs))

537	            rng.shuffle(parts)                # 乱序也应被接受(校验会重排)
538	            answers.append(parts)

540	    return policy

542	pairs = {'rows': (contiguous_split_map((10, 4), [3, 7], 0), replicated_map((10, 4), 2))}
543	plans = plan_transfers(pairs, replica_policy=random_policy(random.Random(7)))
544	print(plans['rows'].statistics)               # 观察 segments_before_merge vs segments

546	
547	然后做一个思想实验（源码阅读型实践）：写一个策略 `lambda rs: [hash(r) % 2 and r.candidates[0].source_rank or r.candidates[-1].source_rank for r in rs]`——它在本进程内「看似确定」，但若不同 rank 对同一逻辑张量的 `hash` 顺序或候选排序有任何分歧就会给出不同答案。对照 [affine_transfer_executor.py:L417-L418](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_transfer_executor.py#L417-L418) 回答：这个策略在真实多 rank 同步中会死在哪一步？
548	
549	**需要观察的现象**：随机策略（含切分、乱序）生成的计划能正常返回；`statistics` 中 `segments_before_merge`（发射前候选段数，含切分产生的多段）大于等于 `segments`（合并后）——`_coalesce` 把相邻可拼的段重新拼起来了。
550	
551	**预期结果**：`plan_transfers` 无异常返回；若进一步套用测试里的 `_assert_moves_exactly`（用 `source_map.extract(full, rank)` 做参考），24 个种子下目标分片全部逐元素相等且写计数全 1——这就是「精确」。思想实验的答案见下面练习 2。待本地验证。
552	
553	#### 4.5.5 小练习与答案
554	
555	**练习 1**：副本**不一致**时（某 holder 的数据坏了），「任意一致的计划都是精确的」还成立吗？协议如何兜底？
556	
557	**答案**：不成立——该定理的前提就是副本一致。协议的兜底在于：holder 集合来自 `_validate_holders` 的「已验证」几何（每个 holder 恰好覆盖该逻辑盒），覆盖的是**位置**正确性；字节一致性属于上层（检查点校验/同步前的数据一致性保障），规划器管不到也不假装管到。这正是 docstring 把责任划在「what arrives is fixed by the maps」的原因。
558	
559	**练习 2**（思想实验答案）：依赖 `hash` 的策略会在哪一步失败？
560	
561	**答案**：在执行器的摘要比对处失败——各 rank 算出的答案不同 → 计划不同 → digest 不同 → `ranks disagree about the transfer schedule (batch schedule)`，整批在数据移动之前被拒绝（这是安全的失败：目标未被污染）。教训：策略的每一步只能依赖全员相同的输入。
562	
563	**练习 3**：为什么 `local_first_least_loaded` 在多 rank 下天然一致，而「选本 rank 最近的 holder」不行？
564	
565	**答案**：`local_first_least_loaded` 的输入只有请求序列（全员相同）+ 全员相同的账本演化规则（固定顺序 + 字典序），没有任何「我这个 rank 是谁」的信息——它模拟的是全图视角。而「离我最近」以 rank 本地身份为输入，不同 rank 答案必然不同。判断一个策略能否安全上多 rank，就看它的决策能否在「无身份的旁观者」手里重放出来。
566	
567	## 5. 综合实践

690	## 6. 本讲小结
691	
692	- **分层**：`plan_transfers` 在 `plan_transfer` 之上只加了「收集排序请求 → 一次调用策略 → 逐答案校验」三件事，`_prepare`/`_emit` 原样复用，单参数行为零变化（由等价性测试固化）。
693	- **协议**：`ReplicaRequest` 按固定顺序（参数、目标 location、origin、extent）携带全部已验证 holder；location 与进程是两个命名空间，靠 `source_processes`/`target_processes` 翻译；单 holder 区域也入列，因为它的负载是策略搬不动的负载。
694	- **三策略**：`first_holder` 复刻单参数默认；`local_first_least_loaded`（批量默认）本地优先 + 最少负载贪心 + 平手取最小 location + 从不切分；`per_request` 把旧选择器零改动包进批量世界。
695	- **校验**：一请求一答、只能选已验证 holder、parts 必须沿 axis 0 精确平铺（gap/重叠/越界/非整数/空 part 全拒）、`min_split_bytes` 只约束切分、`max_pair_checks` 在展开 parts 前按答案长度先拒——违例一律 `InvalidReplicaPolicyError`，一个 segment 都不发射。
696	- **定理**：任意一致的计划都是精确的——策略只决定从哪读、不决定送达什么；副本一致时一切被接受的答案等价，随机策略 × 24 种子的「逐元素相等 + 写计数全 1」测试是它的机器化陈述。
697	- **纪律**：所有 rank 必须返回相同答案（executor 的 digest 比对是执法者），因此成本输入必须来自全员共享的数据（如 #8966 的链路标定 `fit_links`）而非 rank 本地测量——这一层就是 #8252 成本感知策略的接入点。
698	
699	## 7. 下一步学习建议
700	
701	1. **向下落地执行**：本讲止步于「计划」。读 [tests/unit/checkpoint/test_affine_transfer_executor.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/tests/unit/checkpoint/test_affine_transfer_executor.py) 与 [test_affine_transfer_executor_external_group.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/tests/unit/checkpoint/test_affine_transfer_executor_external_group.py)，看 `execute_transfers` 如何用 `TransferRequest` 把多个参数的计划打包成 peer 消息、digest 共识如何与 `StagingBudget` 配合。

703	3. **写一个真正的成本感知策略**：以 `local_first_least_loaded` 为模板，构造一份假想的共享链路模型（例如 `{(进程对): 带宽}`），实现「最小完成时间」指派；用 4.5 的「无身份旁观者可重放」标准自检它在多 rank 下是否一致。这是 #8252 方向的最小原型。

# 批量重副本策略：plan_transfers 与可插拔 replica policy

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u8-l7）我们读懂了 affine 分片迁移的「单参数」通道：`plan_transfer` 把源与目标两张仿射映射组合成一份按 `TransferSegment` 组织的搬运计划。本讲进入 #8936 在其上新增的「批量规划层」，学完后你应该能够：

1. 说清 `plan_transfers` 与 `plan_transfer` 的分工：单参数规划 vs 一次同步全参数批量规划，以及二者如何共享 `_prepare`/`_emit` 这两段校验与发射逻辑（`plan_transfer` 行为完全不变）。
2. 逐字段解读 `ReplicaRequest`/`ReplicaPart`/`ReplicaAnswer` 请求-答案协议：请求按什么固定顺序排列、携带哪些信息、`source_processes`/`target_processes` 如何把「映射 location」翻译成「进程」、为什么单 holder 区域也要入列。
3. 对比三个内置策略：`first_holder`、`local_first_least_loaded`、`per_request(selector)`，并能写出自己的第四个。
4. 列出答案发射前的全部校验：一请求一答、只能选已验证 holder、`ReplicaPart` 必须沿 axis 0 精确平铺（gap/重叠/越界/非整数坐标均拒绝）、`min_split_bytes` 下限、`PlanBudget.max_pair_checks` 预算（且超限在展开 parts 之前按答案长度先拒绝）。
5. 解释两条贯穿性的原理：「任意一致的计划都是精确的」（策略只决定从哪读、不决定送达什么），以及「所有 rank 必须返回相同答案」（每个 rank 各自发射同一调度的一半，executor 的 schedule digest 会拒绝不一致）——后者决定了成本感知策略（#8252）的成本输入必须来自全员共享的数据（如 #8966 的链路标定 `fit_links`），而非 rank 本地测量。

本讲全部代码都可以在纯 CPU、无分布式环境下运行：规划（planning）本身只是纯 Python 计算。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 承接 u8-l7 的认知

本讲默认你已经理解上一讲建立的这些概念，这里只做一句话回温：

- **仿射映射（affine map）**：`ParamAffineMap` 用若干 `AffinePiece`（形状 + source/dest 两侧 strided 视图 + `locations` 副本集 + 可逆 scale）刻画「一个 rank 的分片在完整逻辑张量中的位置」。`replicated_map`（全复制）、`contiguous_split_map`（沿某一维连续切）是两个最常用的构造器。
- **规划（`plan_transfer`）**：把源映射与目标映射组合，为每个「目标 piece 与源区域的交集」选一个读取方（holder），发射为 `TransferSegment`（一条可直接执行的 strided 拷贝：源 rank/offset/strides + 目标 rank/offset/strides + 共享 shape）。
- **`PlanBudget`**：规划器自身工作量的上限（不是正确性约束），防止 piece 数本身是 bug 的映射迫使无界枚举。
- **执行（`execute_transfer`）**：各 rank 先对计划摘要（digest）达成共识，再按轮次协议搬运。

### 2.2 本讲的新直觉：从「逐个问路」到「看全图派活」

`plan_transfer` 的 `replica_selector` 是**逐路口问路**式的：每个有多份副本的区域单独问一次「从哪读」，每次问话互相看不见。这在单参数世界里够用，但一次权重同步（sync）通常要搬成百上千个参数——如果每个区域都独立选「第一个 holder」，所有负载会砸在同一批发送进程上，网络成为瓶颈。

`plan_transfers` 换成**看全图派活**：把一次同步的全部请求按固定顺序排成一列，一次性交给一个「重副本策略」（replica policy），让它统筹决定每个区域从哪读、甚至是否把一个大区域切成几段分给不同发送方。这正是负载均衡（load balancing）的标准建模：

\[ L_s = \sum_{\text{请求 } r \text{ 指派给发送方 } s} \mathrm{size}(r), \qquad \text{目标：让各 } L_s \text{ 尽量均匀} \]

其中 \(\mathrm{size}\) 是请求的字节数（或元素数）。策略输出的不是搬运本身，而只是一份「指派表」——这一点引出本讲最重要的一条定理化结论，见 4.5。

### 2.3 两个容易混淆的「rank」

`ParamAffineMap` 里的 rank 是**映射 location**（源映射与目标映射各自从 0 编号），不是进程号：同一个数字在两侧命名的是不同进程。要把 location 翻译成真正的进程，需要调用方额外提供 `source_processes` / `target_processes` 两张映射表。记住这一点，4.3 里「为什么无映射时不假设本地拷贝」才好理解。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 plan_transfers 批量编排与 _prepare/_emit 复用

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`plan_transfer` 一次规划一个参数；`plan_transfers` 一次规划**一次同步的全部参数**。设计上的关键取舍是：批量层没有另写一套校验，而是原样复用单参数层的两个函数——

- `_prepare(target_map, source_map, budget)`：校验两张映射（几何合法性、分片铺贴、holder 声明一致、源全覆盖），并把目标 piece 切成与源区域的交集（`_Intersection`），每个交集附带「已验证 holder 列表」。
- `_emit(prepared, choices, budget)`：把「(区域, 选定 holder)」对发射成合并后的 `TransferSegment` 并检查计划预算。

因此批量层新增的只有：请求的**收集与排序**、策略的**一次调用**、答案的**逐条校验**（4.4）。`plan_transfer` 的行为一个字节都没变——这一点不是口头承诺，而是被测试固化的契约（见 4.1.4）。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

`plan_transfers` 的执行流程：

1. 校验关键字参数：`source_processes`/`target_processes` 必须是 int→int 映射；`element_size` 对每个参数必须是正 int；`min_split_bytes` 必须是正 int 且**依赖** `element_size`（映射数的是元素，不是字节）。
2. 对 `pairs` 中每个参数（按名字排序）调用 `_prepare`，得到校验过的交集列表。**任何一对映射不合法都会在策略运行之前抛错**。
3. 把所有交集展开为条目 `(参数名, 目标 location, 交集 origin, 交集 extent)` 并排序——这就是「固定顺序」：参数名 → 目标 location → 逻辑 origin → extent。
4. 按该顺序构造 `ReplicaRequest` 元组。
5. 调用策略一次（未传则惰性导入默认策略 `local_first_least_loaded`）。
6. 检查「一请求一答」，然后逐答案走 `_resolve`（4.4）+ 预算检查，得到每个交集的 (区域, holder) 切分。
7. 逐参数调用 `_emit`，返回 `{参数名: TransferPlan}`。

伪代码：

```text
plan_transfers(pairs, ..., replica_policy):
    校验 process/element_size/min_split_bytes 参数
    prepared = {name: _prepare(target, source, budget) for name in sorted(pairs)}
    entries  = [(name, target_rank, origin, extent), ...] 排序
    requests = [ReplicaRequest(...) for entry in entries]
    answers  = (replica_policy or local_first_least_loaded)(requests)
    断言 len(answers) == len(requests)
    for entry, request, answer in zip(entries, requests, answers):
        先按答案长度查预算; parts = _resolve(request, item, answer, ...)
        累计 parts 数并再查预算
    return {name: _emit(prepared[name], choices[name], budget)}
```

### 4.2 ReplicaRequest / ReplicaPart 请求-答案协议

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

策略与规划器之间靠三个冻结 dataclass 通信，构成一个极小的「请求-答案」协议：

- **`ReplicaRequest`（请求）**：一个目标 piece 与一个源区域的交集，附上**全部已验证 holder**。它是一次问话的完整上下文。
- **`ReplicaAnswer`（答案）**：两种形态之二——一个 int（某个已验证 holder 的 location，整段都从它读），或一组 `ReplicaPart`（把区域沿 axis 0 切成几段，每段各指名一个 holder）。
- **`ReplicaPart`（部分）**：一次切分：`logical_origin` + `shape`（沿 axis 0 的一个行带）+ `source_location`（这一段从谁读）。

协议的几个设计决定值得咀嚼：

1. **单 holder 区域也入列**。它们没有选择余地，但它们的字节数是「策略搬不动的负载」——一个诚实的负载均衡者必须把不可移动的负载计入账本，否则它会高估自己的调度自由度。
2. **location 与进程分开**。`target_location` 与 `candidates[i].source_rank` 是两张映射各自的键；`target_process`/`candidate_processes` 才是进程，且未传映射表时为 `None`。这承认了一个现实：源世界与目标世界是两个不同的进程集合。
3. **`bytes` 单独提供**。映射数的是元素，字节需要调用方给 `element_size`。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

一个请求从产出到消费的生命周期：

```text
_prepared[name].intersections 中的每个 _Intersection
    │  (target: 目标 piece 帧, shared: 交集盒子, holders: 已验证 holder 帧元组)
    ▼
ReplicaRequest{parameter, target_location, target_process,
               logical_origin, shape, target_offset, target_strides,
               candidates=(ReplicaCandidate(rank, offset, strides), ...),
               candidate_processes=(...), bytes}
    ▼  全部请求按固定顺序一次性交给策略
策略返回 [answer, ...]    # answer ∈ int | Sequence[ReplicaPart]
    ▼
_resolve: 把答案翻译回 ((LogicalBox, _Frame), ...) 并拒绝一切非法形态
    ▼
_emit: 发射为 TransferSegment
```

`ReplicaCandidate` 里的 `source_offset`/`source_strides` 是「该 holder 的分片内地址」——回想上讲的教训：piece 的 `source_*` 寻址完整逻辑张量、`dest_*` 才寻址分片，所以发给策略的候选地址用的是 holder 帧的 `dest` 侧（`holder.address(shared)`）。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `ReplicaRequest` 要携带 `target_offset`/`target_strides`？策略选 holder 又用不上它们。

**答案**：协议把「策略需要的」与「答案校验/发射需要的」放在同一张请求里，避免规划器另建平行结构；同时 `per_request` 要把请求降级成 `plan_transfer` 风格的 `ReplicaSelectionRequest`（它含同样的目标侧字段，见 [affine_replica_policy.py:L80-L87](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_replica_policy.py#L80-L87)），让旧选择器零改动迁移。

**练习 2**：两个 holder 的 `ReplicaCandidate.source_offset` 一定相同吗？

**答案**：不一定。同一逻辑区域在两个 holder 分片中的局部位置由各自的 `dest` 侧布局决定；构造现场逐 holder 调 `holder.address(item.shared)`（[L607-L608](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_transfer.py#L607-L608)），`_sources` 的 docstring 也点明了这一点（不同目标可用不同 holder，其局部 offset 无需一致）。

**练习 3**：如果 `element_size` 漏了某个参数会怎样？

**答案**：在策略运行之前就抛 `AffineTransferError`（`element_size for 'x' is None, not a positive int`，[L574-L578](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_transfer.py#L574-L578)）——协议要么给全部请求配字节，要么一个都不配。

### 4.3 affine_replica_policy 三策略

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

[affine_replica_policy.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_replica_policy.py) 的模块 docstring 把这一层的设计立场说得很清楚：策略住在这里、不住在规划器里，所以成本感知策略可以独立生长而规划器不变。三个内置策略从简到繁：

| 策略 | 一句话 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `first_holder` | 每个请求取候选中**最小 holder location** | 等价于 `plan_transfer` 默认行为，作对照基线 |
| `local_first_least_loaded` | 目标进程自己持有就本地读；否则发给本批次**已分配字节最少**的发送进程 | `plan_transfers` 的默认策略：能省链路的省链路，剩下的做负载均衡 |
| `per_request(selector)` | 把 `plan_transfer` 风格的逐请求选择器包装成批量策略 | 兼容层：旧选择器零改动进入批量世界 |

`local_first_least_loaded` 的账本规则（docstring [L33-L41](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_replica_policy.py#L33-L41)）四条：

1. **单 holder 请求计入负载**——那份负载搬不动，但占了发送方的带宽；
2. **本地拷贝不计**——它不占用任何链路；
3. **平手取最小 location**，且请求按规划器的固定顺序到达，所以答案是**确定的**（deterministic）；
4. **从不切分**（可以证明：负载均衡问题在这层只用「整段指派」这个动作就够用了，切分留给未来的成本感知策略）。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

`local_first_least_loaded` 对每个请求的判定流程：

```text
for request in requests:                      # 固定顺序
    local = [holder_location for holder, process in zip(candidates, candidate_processes)
             if process is not None and process == target_process]
    if local:                                 # 目标进程自己持有 → 本地读
        answer = min(local);  continue        # 本地拷贝不记账
    sender(i) = ('process', p_i)  若候选带进程号, 否则 ('location', loc_i)
    chosen = argmin_i (load[sender(i)], loc_i)   # 字典序：先负载后 location
    load[sender(chosen)] += request.bytes or request.numel
    answer = candidates[chosen].source_rank
```

形式化地，它是在线贪心地最小化各发送方的累计负载，字典序平手规则 \(\arg\min_i (L_{s_i}, \ell_i)\) 保证唯一确定的选择。

注意 `sender` 的键设计：有进程映射时按**进程**记账（两个 location 指向同一进程时负载合并），无映射时退化为按 location 记账——因为「同一数字在两侧命名不同进程」，无映射时绝不能假设 location 相同就是本地拷贝。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`local_first_least_loaded` 为什么「从不切分」也不损害正确性？

**答案**：切分是**性能**动作不是正确性动作——4.5 将证明副本一致时任何被接受的答案（整段指派或合法切分）送达的数据相同。不做切分只是放弃了把大区域摊到多个发送方的能力，这个能力留给未来的成本感知策略通过同一个协议提供。

**练习 2**：请求到达顺序为什么对 `local_first_least_loaded` 是正确性问题而不仅是性能问题？

**答案**：它的账本 `load` 是跨请求累积的在线状态；如果两个 rank 上请求顺序不同，同一策略会算出不同答案，而 executor 要求所有 rank 答案一致（4.5）——否则触发 digest 拒绝。固定顺序（参数、目标 location、origin）+ 字典序平手规则共同把「相同输入 ⇒ 相同答案」钉死。

**练习 3**：写一个「随机选 holder」的策略需要几行？

**答案**：`lambda requests: [random.choice([c.source_rank for c in r.candidates]) for r in requests]` 一行即可——但注意跨 rank 一致性：随机源必须由全员相同的种子驱动（见 4.5 与综合实践）。

### 4.4 答案校验、min_split_bytes 与 pair budget

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

规划器对答案的态度是**先验证后发射**：任何一条答案不合格，整次规划抛 `InvalidReplicaPolicyError`（[L64-L69](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_transfer.py#L64-L69)），**一个 segment 都不会发出**。校验分四组：

1. **形状**：答案序列必须一请求一答、是真序列（生成器/字符串拒绝）。
2. **int 答案**：`type(answer) is int` 且必须是**该请求已验证 holder** 之一。注意 `type(...) is int` 连 `True`（bool 是 int 的子类）和 `1.0` 都拒绝——一个布尔或浮点在这里只会是 bug。
3. **parts 答案**：每个元素必须是 `ReplicaPart`；`source_location` 必须是已验证 holder 的 int；`logical_origin`/`shape` 必须是维度与请求盒一致的 int 元组；必须**沿 axis 0 平铺整个区域**：除首轴外的每一维都要与请求盒完全一致（即只许切首轴），行方向上从请求首行走到末行、不许 gap、不许重叠、不许提前停或冲出界外；不许空 part；标量（0 维）不可切分。
4. **尺寸与预算**：给了 `min_split_bytes` 时，**切分**（parts 数 > 1）的每个 part 折算字节后不得低于下限（未切分的整段答案永远不会「太小」）；每个参数累计的 parts 总数不得超过 `PlanBudget.max_pair_checks`（默认 \(2^{18}\)），且超限在 parts 被逐个展开**之前**就按答案长度拒绝。

axis-0 平铺的数学表述：请求盒首轴范围 \([r_0, r_0 + n)\)，则 parts 排序后须满足

\[ p_0 = r_0, \qquad p_{i+1} = p_i + m_i, \qquad p_{k-1} + m_{k-1} = r_0 + n \]

其中 \(p_i\)、\(m_i\) 是第 i 个 part 的首轴 origin 与长度。这个「行走」证明同时给出无 gap（\(p_{i+1} \geq p_i + m_i\) 的等号情形）与无重叠。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

`_resolve` 的判定流程：

```text
answer 是 int?
    是 → 在 holders 字典里? 否 → InvalidReplicaPolicyError
         返回 [(整个交集盒, 该 holder)]
answer 是非空序列?
    否 → InvalidReplicaPolicyError
    逐 part: 必须是 ReplicaPart; source_location 是已验证 holder;
             origin/shape 是 ndim 维 int 元组; 非首轴维度与请求盒一致;
             不许空 part
    标量(ndim==0): 只许恰好 1 个 part
    parts 按首轴 origin 排序
    行走: row 从盒首行出发, 每个 part 必须恰从 row 开始
          origin < row → overlap; origin > row → gap; 走完必须停在盒末行
    len(parts)>1 且给了 min_split_bytes: 每 part 体积×元素字节 ≥ 下限
    返回 [(part 盒, 对应 holder), ...]
```

为什么「与请求盒比对」而不是「parts 互相比对」？`_resolve` 的 docstring（[L661-L666](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_transfer.py#L661-L666)）给出理由：每个 part 按构造只能沿首轴切且其余轴与请求盒一致，所以「从请求首行走到末行」本身就证明了互不相交又无缝隙——不需要两两对比 parts 的声明。

**练习 1**：策略返回 `[ReplicaPart((0,0),(2,4),0), ReplicaPart((3,0),(3,4),1)]`（跳过第 2 行）会被哪一行拒绝？报错怎么说？

**练习 2**：为什么「未切分的整段答案不受 `min_split_bytes` 约束」是合理设计而不是漏洞？

**答案**：`min_split_bytes` 的语义是「别为了均衡切出太碎的片」——约束的是策略的**切分行为**，不是数据本身的尺寸。单 holder 的区域本来就只能是那个尺寸，拒绝它只会让协议把「没得选」也当成错误。

**练习 3**：`max_pair_checks` 同时约束规划器的哪些内部检查与策略的 parts 数？为什么策略侧的检查要提前到展开之前？

**答案**：规划器侧它约束源区域两两相交检查、holder 覆盖检查、目标×源配对数、覆盖并集检查（上讲已读）；策略侧约束每参数 parts 总数。提前的原因在 [L629-L631](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_transfer.py#L629-L631) 的注释：预算约束的是规划器的工作量，若先展开再查，超长答案（可能几十万个 part）已经白白做了展开工作才被拒绝。

### 4.5 跨 rank 一致性与共享成本输入

#### 4.5.1 概念说明

这一节是整层的理论地基，两句话构成一对此消彼长的约束：

**第一句：任意一致的计划都是精确的（"Any consistent plan is exact"）。**
策略只决定**数据从哪里读**，不决定**送达什么**。副本一致（同一逻辑区域的每个已验证 holder 持有相同字节）时，无论策略选哪个 holder、怎么切分，任何被接受的答案送达的数据都相同。测试文件的 docstring 直接把它归到 affine IR 正确性论证（#8252 证明草案）名下：[test_affine_replica_policy.py:L5-L15](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/tests/unit/checkpoint/test_affine_replica_policy.py#L5-L15)。这就把「策略可以随便选」从鲁莽变成了安全——规划器用 4.4 的校验收口，校验之内自由。

**第二句：所有 rank 必须返回相同答案。**
执行时每个 rank 只发射同一调度中属于自己的那一半（自己持有的源、自己负责的目标），所以所有 rank 必须先对「整张调度」达成一致。执行器把每个 rank 的批量调度摘要（digest）收集比对，不一致直接拒绝：`'ranks disagree about the transfer schedule (batch schedule)'`，见 [affine_transfer_executor.py:L417-L418](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_transfer_executor.py#L417-L418)。`plan_transfers` 的 docstring 原样引用了这条报错（[L556-L560](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_transfer.py#L556-L560)）。

两句合起来的工程推论：**策略的成本输入必须来自全员共享的数据**。如果某个 rank 用自己测的链路带宽做决策而别的 rank 测出不同的数，答案就会分叉、digest 拒绝、同步失败。所以成本感知策略（#8252 的目标）只能吃「每 rank 都一样」的输入——例如 #8966 计划的链路标定（`fit_links`）：先跨 rank 收集测量、拟合成一份共识链路模型，再交给策略。`affine_replica_policy` 的模块 docstring 把这条纪律写成了设计前提（[L13-L15](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_replica_policy.py#L13-L15)）：带状态的策略可以是任何可调用对象，规划器不持有状态；其答案必须在同步的每个 rank 上一致，故成本输入永远不能来自 rank 本地测量。

#### 4.5.2 核心流程

一次真实同步中「规划一致 → 执行一致」的闭环：

```text
所有 rank: 用相同的 pairs + 相同的(确定性)策略各自调 plan_transfers
        │  (策略输入: 全员相同的 maps / element_size / 共享成本模型)
        ▼
所有 rank 得到字节级相同的计划 → 摘要 digest 相同
        │
        ▼
execute_transfers: 各 rank 摘要 all-gather 比对
        ├─ 有 rank 拒绝 → 'a rank rejected the transfer batch before it began'
        ├─ digest 不一致 → 'ranks disagree about the transfer schedule (batch schedule)'
        └─ 一致 → 各 rank 发射自己那一半(本地源→远端目标 / 远端源→本地目标)
```

#### 4.5.3 源码精读

随机策略测试是「任意一致的计划都是精确的」的机器化陈述：[test_affine_replica_policy.py:L77-L110](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/tests/unit/checkpoint/test_affine_replica_policy.py#L77-L110)。`_random_policy` 对每个请求或随机选 holder、或沿 axis 0 随机切 1~3 刀并给每刀随机 holder（还把 parts 顺序打乱——校验会重排序，所以乱序答案也应被接受）；`test_every_accepted_answer_moves_the_same_data` 跑 24 个种子，每个计划经 `_apply_plan` 在朴素缓冲上执行后断言两件事：目标分片与「`extract` 直取的参考分片」逐元素相等（`torch.equal`，fp64），且**每个元素恰好被写一次**（writes 计数全 1）——「精确」一词的可执行含义。

`_apply_plan`/`_assert_moves_exactly` 这两个测试脚手架：[test_affine_replica_policy.py:L40-L60](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/tests/unit/checkpoint/test_affine_replica_policy.py#L40-L60)。注释明确它们「是测试脚手架，绝不是生产路径」——生产执行走 executor 的轮次协议与 staging 预算，而这里用 `torch.as_strided` + 写计数在单进程内模拟，正适合用来验证「计划语义」本身。

执行侧的 digest 执法：[deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_transfer_executor.py:L414-L418](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/deepspeed/checkpoint/affine_transfer_executor.py#L414-L418)。`decisions` 是各 rank 对「本批调度摘要 + 是否拒绝」的表态；任何一个 rank 拒绝则整批不动数据；摘要集合大小不为 1 即分叉。这是「规划层要求一致」在执行层的对应物——两层共同把「一致」变成硬约束而非君子协定。

文档中对应的一句契约：[docs/code-docs/source/affine-transfer.rst:L71-L75](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84679e9d3a2582bffc53a5259d13cfc7278c9772/docs/code-docs/source/affine-transfer.rst#L71-L75)——「Every rank must return the same answers, so cost inputs must come from data every rank shares, such as a link calibration gathered across ranks, never from a rank-local measurement.」

```python
from deepspeed.checkpoint.affine import contiguous_split_map, replicated_map
from deepspeed.checkpoint.affine_transfer import ReplicaPart, plan_transfers

def random_policy(rng):
    def policy(requests):
        answers = []
        for r in requests:
            locs = [c.source_rank for c in r.candidates]
            rows = r.shape[0] if r.shape else 1
            if not r.shape or rows == 1 or rng.random() < 0.4:
                answers.append(rng.choice(locs)); continue
            cuts = sorted(rng.sample(range(1, rows), rng.randint(1, min(3, rows - 1))))

                                 (e - s,) + r.shape[1:], rng.choice(locs))
                     for s, e in zip(starts, ends)]
            rng.shuffle(parts)                # 乱序也应被接受(校验会重排)
            answers.append(parts)
        return answers
    return policy
```

#### 4.5.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：副本**不一致**时（某 holder 的数据坏了），「任意一致的计划都是精确的」还成立吗？协议如何兜底？

**答案**：不成立——该定理的前提就是副本一致。协议的兜底在于：holder 集合来自 `_validate_holders` 的「已验证」几何（每个 holder 恰好覆盖该逻辑盒），覆盖的是**位置**正确性；字节一致性属于上层（检查点校验/同步前的数据一致性保障），规划器管不到也不假装管到。这正是 docstring 把责任划在「what arrives is fixed by the maps」的原因。

**练习 2**（思想实验答案）：依赖 `hash` 的策略会在哪一步失败？

**答案**：在执行器的摘要比对处失败——各 rank 算出的答案不同 → 计划不同 → digest 不同 → `ranks disagree about the transfer schedule (batch schedule)`，整批在数据移动之前被拒绝（这是安全的失败：目标未被污染）。教训：策略的每一步只能依赖全员相同的输入。

**练习 3**：为什么 `local_first_least_loaded` 在多 rank 下天然一致，而「选本 rank 最近的 holder」不行？

**答案**：`local_first_least_loaded` 的输入只有请求序列（全员相同）+ 全员相同的账本演化规则（固定顺序 + 字典序），没有任何「我这个 rank 是谁」的信息——它模拟的是全图视角。而「离我最近」以 rank 本地身份为输入，不同 rank 答案必然不同。判断一个策略能否安全上多 rank，就看它的决策能否在「无身份的旁观者」手里重放出来。

```python
import torch

from deepspeed.checkpoint.affine import contiguous_split_map, replicated_map
from deepspeed.checkpoint.affine_transfer import (InvalidReplicaPolicyError, PlanBudget, ReplicaPart,
                                                  plan_transfer, plan_transfers)
from deepspeed.checkpoint.affine_replica_policy import first_holder, local_first_least_loaded, per_request

def product(shape):
    n = 1
    for s in shape:
        n *= s
    return n

def apply_plan(plan, target_map, source_shards):     # 改写自测试脚手架 _apply_plan
    targets = {r: (torch.full((product(s),), -12345.0, dtype=torch.float64),
                   torch.zeros(product(s), dtype=torch.int64)) for r, s in target_map.shard_shapes.items()}
    for seg in plan.segments:
        src = torch.as_strided(source_shards[seg.source_rank].reshape(-1), seg.shape,
                               seg.source_strides, seg.source_offset)
        values, writes = targets[seg.target_rank]
        torch.as_strided(values, seg.shape, seg.target_strides, seg.target_offset).copy_(src)
        torch.as_strided(writes, seg.shape, seg.target_strides, seg.target_offset).add_(1)
    return targets

def assert_exact(plan, source_map, target_map, full):
    sources = {r: source_map.extract(full, r).contiguous() for r in source_map.shard_shapes}
    for rank, (values, writes) in apply_plan(plan, target_map, sources).items():
        assert torch.equal(values.view(target_map.shard_shapes[rank]), target_map.extract(full, rank))
        assert bool(torch.all(writes == 1)), f'rank {rank} 写计数异常'

    'dense': (contiguous_split_map((12, 6), [2, 4], 1), replicated_map((12, 6), 3)),
    'rows':  (contiguous_split_map((10, 4), [3, 7], 0), replicated_map((10, 4), 2)),
}

# 第 1 步：等价性——批量层没有改变单参数行为
plans = plan_transfers(pairs, replica_policy=first_holder)
for name, (t, s) in pairs.items():
    assert plans[name] == plan_transfer(t, s), name

# 第 2 步：随机策略（随机 holder + axis 0 随机切分 + 乱序 parts）——任意一致的计划都是精确的
def random_policy(rng):
    def policy(requests):
        out = []
        for r in requests:
            locs = [c.source_rank for c in r.candidates]
            rows = r.shape[0] if r.shape else 1
            if not r.shape or rows == 1 or rng.random() < 0.4:
                out.append(rng.choice(locs)); continue
            cuts = sorted(rng.sample(range(1, rows), rng.randint(1, min(3, rows - 1))))
            parts = [ReplicaPart((r.logical_origin[0] + a,) + r.logical_origin[1:],
                                 (b - a,) + r.shape[1:], rng.choice(locs))
                     for a, b in zip([0] + cuts, cuts + [rows])]
            rng.shuffle(parts)
            out.append(parts)
        return out
    return policy

for seed in range(24):
    plans = plan_transfers(pairs, replica_policy=random_policy(random.Random(seed)))

# 第 3 步：自定义负载均衡策略（轮流指派 + 本地优先），对照默认策略的分布
def round_robin_local(requests):
    turn, answers = 0, []
    for r in requests:
        local = [c.source_rank for c, p in zip(r.candidates, r.candidate_processes)
                 if p is not None and p == r.target_process]
        if local:
            answers.append(min(local)); continue
        multi = [c.source_rank for c in r.candidates]
        answers.append(multi[turn % len(multi)]); turn += 1
    return answers
```

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.
